llm_summary.cluster_overall_function: Facilitate the discovery and purchase of bundled VIP membership packages across multiple entertainment platforms.
key_functional_capabilities: Display discounted bundled VIP membership options (e.g., NetEase Cloud Music + Mango TV, Youku, etc.)
Enable one-click purchase via prominent “即时开通” (Activate Now) buttons
Present promotional pricing with visual cues such as percentage discounts (e.g., “限时3.7折”) and original price strikethroughs
Recommend personalized or popular bundles through a “猜你喜欢” (You Might Like) module
Highlight special campaigns or rewards (e.g., “500杯奶茶免费送”) to incentivize purchases
Allow browsing of all available joint membership deals via navigation elements like “全部联合会员”
representative_page_types: Joint Membership Zone / Special Offer Landing Page (“联合会员专区”)
Joint Membership Purchase Page (“联合会员”) with detailed bundle options and promotions
Cross-platform Membership Bundle Promotion Pages (featuring partner brand logos and pricing)
likely_user_tasks: Compare and select a bundled VIP membership that covers multiple services (music, video streaming, etc.)
Purchase a cost-effective combined membership to access premium content across platforms
Take advantage of limited-time discounts or promotional rewards (e.g., free gifts)
Discover new or recommended membership bundles based on preferences
Navigate to view all available joint membership options in one place
